name: Hauntibles
detailed_description:
Hauntibles – A Fast-Paced, Co-Op Supernatural Adventure

Hauntibles is a 4-player cooperative PvE action shooter where teamwork is the key to survival. Players step into the shoes of young spirit hunters, torn between their everyday lives and an ancient duty to keep the supernatural world in check. Each character carries personal baggage and unique abilities, but together, they form an unstoppable team—fighting, falling, and rising again to face an evolving, mysterious threat.

Core Gameplay & Features:

  • Dynamic Teamwork – Players must think and act as a single unit, solving puzzles, sharing loot, healing, and even sacrificing for each other. The game rewards teamwork with unique boons and upgrades.

  • Fast-Paced Combat – A fun, fluid shooter that’s easy to pick up but offers deep skill trees for those who want to master their playstyle.

  • Stylized & Whimsical Art – A vibrant, supernatural world blending eerie, corrupted landscapes with stunning, majestic castles, appealing to all demographics.

  • Progression & Customization – Players upgrade unique weapons and abilities after each run, unlocking hidden game lore and secrets.

  • Player Hub & Social Features – Customize and decorate personal rooms. Visit friends' hubs, trade treasures, and unlock even more customization options.

  • The Spirit World Unfolds – A rich supernatural story where the line between the real world and the ghostly realm is breaking. Players must uncover why the haunts are no longer afraid of the living—and what they’re planning next.

The Vision:

Hauntibles is designed to bring players together. Every session strengthens team bonds, and the better you work together, the stronger you become. Whether you're uncovering hidden secrets, perfecting your combat synergy, or just hanging out in the player hub, Hauntibles is a co-op adventure that keeps players coming back for more.

Are you ready to face the haunts, master your role, and rewrite your destiny?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD FX-8350 or Intel Core i5-3570 processor
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX470 or Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 4GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel Core i7-4770
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 590 8GB or Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
